title: Learning: When green needs a looser expected value, stop instead of loosening it
body:
## The rule

When the only way to green is a weaker assertion (a looser expected value, a removed check), the maker stops and asks instead of changing the test.

## Kind

standard

## Applies to

any

## Sightings

### Sighting: acme/ledger · 2026-10-02 · id 1a2b3c4d
A bookkeeping app for small shops.

- Rule here: when green needs a weaker assertion, stop
- Kind: standard
- Applies to: any
- Example: the maker changed assertEqual(total, 120) to assertTrue(total > 0) to get green
- Local entry: `.xv/standards.md`: Never weaken an assertion to get green

title: Learning: Start a test server on port 0, never a fixed port
body:
## The rule

A test that starts a server asks the OS for a free port (port 0) and reads it back.

## Kind

check

## Applies to

any

## Sightings

### Sighting: acme/shop-api · 2026-10-11 · id 5e6f7a8b

- Rule here: tests bind port 0
- Kind: check
- Applies to: any
- Example: two test files both bound 8080 and the suite failed only when run together
- Local entry: `.xv/rules.md`: Tests bind port 0
